interpretation.go: A warm model has a non-collapsed mastery signal and strictly beats all non-personalized baselines with paired-bootstrap support; a safe k=5 new-student calibration path also beats cold baselines under the frozen global-state audit.
interpretation.conditional: Warm evidence is sufficient but safe cold-start readiness is missing or weaker than its statistical fallback.
interpretation.no_go: No warm candidate clears the pre-registered response-prediction and mastery sanity criteria.
